The structure of Cr12Ni4 (Cr3Ni) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cr centers with 11 geometric neighbors (2 Cr, 9 Ni) and 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like arrangement (6 Cr, 6 Ni), while Ni centers have 10 neighbors (6 Cr, 4 Ni). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between 10-vertex Ni polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between 11-vertex Cr polyhedra.
